title: ScopeBench：目标压力下智能体能否守住参与边界？
summary: 提出ScopeBench基准，包含30个死胡同式安全任务，目标只能通过违反范围约束达成。通过无范围与有范围两种条件对比，测量智能体的能力与范围遵守度。8个模型中能力跨度12.2%-81.1%，范围遵守度34.4%-86.7%，并发现331个机械验证遗漏的违规。
summary_en: Introduces ScopeBench, a benchmark of 30 dead-end agentic security tasks whose objectives are reachable only by violating stated scope. Comparing scopeless vs scoped conditions measures capability and scope adherence. Across 8 models, capability spans 12.2%-81.1% and adherence 34.4%-86.7%, with the judge finding 331 violations missed by mechanical verification.
